title: NABJ Scholarships, Grants and Fellowships
summary: Scholarships, fellowships, grants and career-development opportunities for students and emerging Black journalists.
eligibility: Requirements vary by individual NABJ opportunity and may include membership, enrollment, academic work and demonstrated commitment to journalism.

title: NAHJ Journalism Scholarships
summary: Scholarship support for undergraduate and graduate students pursuing careers in English- or Spanish-language journalism.
eligibility: Students planning journalism careers who meet the current requirements for an individual NAHJ scholarship.

title: AAJA Scholarships, Internship Grants and Fellowships
award: More than $20,000 awarded annually across programs
summary: Multiple scholarships, grants and fellowships supporting students and emerging AAPI journalists.
eligibility: Requirements and deadlines vary; many opportunities require AAJA membership and demonstrated commitment to journalism and AAPI communities.

title: Mary Quon Moy Ing Memorial Scholarship
summary: Scholarship for a graduating high school senior planning to study journalism or pursue a journalism career.
eligibility: Graduating high school seniors who are active AAJA members and demonstrate academic and journalistic achievement, financial need and community involvement.

title: IJA-ASU-ICT Graduate Fellowship
provider: Indigenous Journalists Association, Arizona State University and ICT
award: Graduate fellowship support; consult current program details
institution: Arizona State University Walter Cronkite School
summary: Graduate fellowship supporting an Indigenous student completing a Cronkite journalism master's degree while producing journalism with ICT.
eligibility: Indigenous graduate journalism applicants who meet current IJA and Arizona State University admission and fellowship requirements.

title: AES Educational Foundation Graduate Studies Grants
summary: Annual graduate grants for exemplary students dedicated to the art and science of audio engineering.
eligibility: AES student members pursuing eligible graduate-level audio engineering studies and meeting the foundation's academic requirements.

title: Mary Lea Simpson Memorial Scholarship
summary: Tuition scholarship for a final-year undergraduate audio-engineering or recording-arts student.
eligibility: AES student members in the final year of an undergraduate audio engineering or recording arts program at a North American institution.

title: John Lennon Award
summary: Annual competition for student songwriters and composers working in contemporary musical genres.
eligibility: Eligible U.S. residents ages 17–24 submitting qualifying original work not assigned to a major publisher or record label.

title: Dolly Parton Songwriters Award
award: $20,000 for up to two original song entries
summary: Nationwide career-grant competition for emerging songwriters in country, Americana, folk, roots and related genres.
eligibility: Eligible U.S. residents ages 17–24 submitting qualifying original work not assigned to a major publisher or record label.

title: peermusic Latin Music Award
summary: Annual competition for student songwriters and composers creating original music in any Latin genre.
eligibility: Applicants ages 17–24 based in the United States or Puerto Rico who submit qualifying original Latin music.

title: Kavi Ohri Memorial Scholarship
award: Scholarship amount announced with the current cycle
summary: Annual scholarship for a New York City high school senior planning to pursue a college music or music-business major.
eligibility: Seniors attending high school in one of New York City's five boroughs who plan to attend college in a music-related major.

title: AWM Foundation and NCTA Scholarship
provider: Alliance for Women in Media Foundation and NCTA
award: $10,000 and a Gracies Leadership Awards ticket
summary: Scholarship for a female communications or media student who will create an original multimedia project.
eligibility: Female undergraduate or graduate students attending an accredited U.S. college or university in 2027; media-career candidates are encouraged.

title: AWM-DFW Scholarship Program
provider: Dallas Area Alliance for Women in Media Foundation
summary: Multiple scholarships honoring North Texas media leaders and supporting women preparing for media careers.
eligibility: Students attending qualifying Texas institutions and studying radio, television, film, PR, advertising, communications or broadcasting.

title: AWM Austin Scholarship
provider: Alliance for Women in Media Austin
award: $5,000 in the most recently announced cycle
summary: Undergraduate scholarship supporting a woman studying media or a related field in the Austin area.
eligibility: College sophomores or juniors studying media near Austin, or qualifying students with an Austin-area high school and permanent address.

title: MJ Bear Fellowship
award: Conference registration, travel support and professional development
summary: Fellowship recognizing and supporting promising early-career digital journalists.
eligibility: Working digital journalists age 30 or younger who meet the Online News Association's current fellowship criteria.
